[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

[[Category:Gortin Townland, Derryloran Parish, County Tyrone]]
== Biography ==
Sally was Confirmed in 1843 as a 17-year-old living in Gortin, Derryloran ,County Tyrone.

She may have been the daughter of [[Glasgow-2054|Samuel Glasgow]] and [[McCormick-8286|Ann McCormick]].

== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-2054]] is assessed at 78% (probable). Sally's 1843 Gortin confirmation at 17 fits the small Samuel/Hugh family cluster, with Letitia and Thomas appearing in the same parish sequence and independently naming Samuel. The register supplies residence and age, not Sally's parent names, so Samuel is a probable working inference rather than a recorded father.

Selected Glasgow-2054 fatherhood of Glasgow-2543; maternal identity and upstream ancestry are separate.

Next useful test: Find Sally's baptism or later marriage naming father.

Source basis already held: [https://www.wikitree.com/wiki/Glasgow-2543 The Parish Registers of Derryloran parish church V2]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.


=== Parents ===
Gortin was a small townland we have only seen evidence so far of two couples with children living there; Samuel, and his brother Hugh.

Of the six Glasgows of Gortin confirmed in the same parish register, three of the other names (James, Letitia and Thomas) match people already known to be children of these parents. (see Samuel's profile for a list)

=== Fate ===
No obvious entries in the civil registration for Sarah or Sally Glasgow; so she might have died before 1864, or emigrated.

* [[Glasgow-1719|Sarah (Glasgow) Mahood (abt.1827-1900)]] can be ruled out as she is named by her married name in her father's will, a different Samuel Glasgow.
* [[Glasgow-1180|Sarah (Glasgow) Kermode (abt.1826-1894)]], daughter of Hugh and Margaret, has a passenger log of arriving in Australia in 1842, so probably was not in Cookstown in 1843. 
* [[Glasgow-1172|Sarah Glasgow (1824-1894)]] (Allegheny NY) different parents.
